purpose.zh: 练肩带控制，为倒立类动作做准备
purpose.en: Build shoulder-girdle control to prepare for overhead support work.

text.zh: 派克位手臂伸直，肩膀推向耳朵再放下
text.en: In a pike with straight arms, push your shoulders toward your ears, then lower

text.zh: 肘保持接近伸直，不弯臂
text.en: Keep your elbows nearly straight without bending.

commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows into a pike push-up.

cautions.zh: 先确保派克支撑无痛；手腕或肩不适就停止
cautions.en: Make sure a pike hold is pain-free first, and stop if your wrists or shoulders feel uncomfortable.

cautions.zh: 先做 1 组轻松的 4–6 次
cautions.en: Start with one easy set of 4–6 reps.
